messages.subject: Re: Graphics problem
parts:
Hi Kennen,

This sounds like a non-rattle specific problem given the issues with Plot Builder and GGobi.

I assume you are on MS/Windows? Are you using the latest version of R (2.15.2) and Rattle (2.6.26)?

The XML dll for R gets installed when you install the XML package in R:

> install.packages("XML")

If the dll is still missing then perhaps there are issues with your PATH environment variable? 

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com


On 4 February 2013 06:07, Kennen <kennen...@gmail.com> wrote:
Whenever trying to look at any graphed results for example "Draw" in Tree model, the screen pops up but is
blank. I also have trouble when trying to use plot builder. When I set up a plot to run it just shows the word "plotting" and never produces
an output. A third problem and maybe insight on the underlying problem, when I click on GGobi I get a message that says "The program can't start because libxml2-2.dll is missing from your computer". I have not been able to figure out how to find and install
libxml2-2.dll.

Thank you  in advance for any advice you might be able to offer.

--
